observations: The selector consumes an already-parsed 24-byte material-entry array from container+0x10.
The selector call site carries the exact material slot/index but does not carry raw FLVER file bytes as an explicit argument.
The current selector detour therefore has sufficient state for exact material pointer + material slot, but not yet a proven source for the canonical raw FLVER SHA-256.

runtime_contract.next_cut: identify and hook the upstream FLVER load/parse ownership point, or prove an existing parsed-owner field transports the canonical raw FLVER identity, then bind that identity to the selector container/owner lifetime

guardrail: Do not substitute container pointer, owner pointer, truncated hash, MTD identity, or structural similarity for raw FLVER SHA-256.
